notes.title: Orbitect Patch Notes - Version 1.2.1
notes.content:
Hey Orbitects!

We've got a few more quality of life improvements that we've added to the game, listed below:

We’ve introduced a fix to battery and wire logic to increase stability and reduce crashing in latter waves.

As a fail safe, we have also introduced Wave Point Boosts being earned after each wave, and not after each run.

We’ve fixed the completion screen that wasn’t displaying correctly upon game completion.

We’ve fixed the Achievements bug that wasn’t trigger upon game completion.

We’ve introduced “play in background" (I.e the game will no longer pause when minimised or unfocused).

Thanks for playing!
~Propulsion Games

notes.title: Orbitect Patch Notes - Version 1.2
notes.content:
Hey Orbitects!

We’ve just put out our latest patch which includes some quality of life improvements to the game, listed below.

[list]
[*] Added a tips page to the main menu to help new players
[*] Reduced voice line trigger, randomised for each playthrough
[*] Fixed random seed generator
[*] Removed "low hp warning" label from blocks and panels
[*] Reduced the amount of red flashing on blocks and panels. Flashing will now only occur when a block or panel is at or below 20% of it's max HP
[/list]

Thanks!

~ Propulsion Games

notes.title: Orbitect Patch Notes - Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hey Orbitects!

We’ve just put out our latest patch which includes some balance tweaks under the hood. Chiefly, we’ve redressed the pricing of [b]Wave Point Boosts[/b], the permanent power ups you can acquire to improve your station between runs.

The starting boosts have been made cheaper, allowing players to make improvements earlier on! Note, however, this means that [i]subsequent[/i] boosts have been made a little more expensive to compensate.

[b]If you’ve been playing for a while and have already purchased a number of boosts, please use the RESET button and then re-spec your build using the new, lower costs. You should now be able to afford a lot more of them… :)[/b]

Good luck on your journey to wave 100!

~ Propulsion Games

notes.title: Some small but mighty Demo updates!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a fantastic Next Fest week so far and we've been thrilled at how many people have checked out the demo! We've been busy collating all your feedback, reading your comments, and even watching (/lurking?!) one or two of your livestreams - and we've made a few small but meaningful updates that will hopefully mean even more fun for everyone!

[list]
[*] 🎯[b] We've introduced overkilling debris[/b]. If your weapons destroy an entire piece of debris right off the bat with a single hit, you'll instantly get all of the credits and resources for that without the debris first breaking up into more pieces. This mean you'll be earning more money and resources to spend on your station much earlier.

[*]🛠️[b] We've made it clearer when you're in build mode[/b] vs. when you're in view mode. Because time passes more slowly in build mode, not being sure what mode you're in meant that the game felt slower when spending most time building. We've got plans to make this work even better in the future, but hopefully this little tweak will help in the meantime.

[*]🎓[B] You can skip parts of the tutorial [/b]if you don't fancy hearing all of the instructional dulcet tones of our wonderful narrator.
[/list]
That's all for now! Enjoy! Wishlist! Play! Live! Thrive!
